title: Lesson 20 - The Room Isn't Ready Yet

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Hi. We have a reservation under Lena Ortiz for a standard room with a desk.

lines.speaker: Front desk agent
lines.text: I found it. I'm sorry, but the room isn't ready yet. Housekeeping has been delayed.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: I understand, but we were told it would be ready by three. I have an online call in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Front desk agent
lines.text: I'm sorry about that. We can offer two options.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Before we decide, is there somewhere we can leave our bags?

lines.speaker: Front desk agent
lines.text: Yes. Luggage storage is beside the front desk.

lines.speaker: Front desk agent
lines.text: You can wait for the original room, which should be ready by four. Or we can offer another room now. It's quieter, but it doesn't have a desk.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: If we wait, when will it be ready at the latest?

lines.speaker: Front desk agent
lines.text: By four. You may use the work lounge for your call.

lines.speaker: Front desk agent
lines.text: Take the elevator to the second floor and follow the signs for the courtyard. The lounge is across from the elevator.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: We'd prefer to keep the original room because we need the desk. We'll store the bags and use the lounge until four.

lines.speaker: Front desk agent
lines.text: That works. I'll text you as soon as the room is ready.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Could you confirm that the room still has a desk?

lines.speaker: Front desk agent
lines.text: Yes—standard room, courtyard side, with a desk.
